smoke_test.check: wrapper self-test (python wrapper.py) in the Legwork sandbox, network off

entrypoint: Trim and transcode local video files using MoviePy (FFmpeg pre-downloaded for offline use)
install_command:
pip install moviepy==2.2.1
mkdir -p .imageio
IMAGEIO_USERDIR=./.imageio python -c "import imageio_ffmpeg,sys; sys.stdout.write(imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe())"

known_answer.derived_from: clip.mp4 was generated with ffmpeg as a 3-second 320x240 testsrc video at 15 fps (no audio), so the tool must report duration 3.0 s, 15 fps and size 320x240
